settings.auto_delete.visibilities.descri.description: Help of the visibilities whose posts the automatic deletion keeps.

settings.auto_delete.min_boosts.description: Label of the select of the number of boosts that keeps a post from the automatic deletion.

settings.auto_delete.min_favourites.description: Label of the select of the number of favourites that keeps a post from the automatic deletion.

settings.auto_delete.threshold.off.description: Option of the boosts or favourites threshold of the automatic deletion that keeps no post for it.

settings.auto_delete.threshold.count.description: Option of the boosts or favourites threshold of the automatic deletion: a number of boosts or favourites.

settings.auto_delete.save.description: Button that saves the automatic deletion settings.

settings.auto_delete.saved_on.defaultMessage: Saved. Posts older than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} will be deleted, except those you keep.
settings.auto_delete.saved_on.description: Status after the automatic deletion settings were saved turned on.

settings.auto_delete.saved_off.defaultMessage: Saved. Your posts are not deleted automatically.
settings.auto_delete.saved_off.description: Status after the automatic deletion settings were saved turned off.

settings.auto_delete.save_failed.defaultMessage: The settings could not be saved: {reason}
settings.auto_delete.save_failed.description: Error after saving the automatic deletion settings failed. {reason} is the localized reason.

settings.auto_delete.unsaved.title.description: Title of the dialog that asks before leaving the automatic deletion settings with unsaved changes.

settings.auto_delete.unsaved.description.defaultMessage: Your changes to the automatic deletion will be lost.
settings.auto_delete.unsaved.description.description: Description of the dialog that asks before leaving the automatic deletion settings with unsaved changes.

settings.auto_delete.unsaved.leave.description: Button that leaves the automatic deletion settings without saving.

settings.auto_delete.unsaved.stay.description: Button that stays on the automatic deletion settings.

settings.two_factor.status.title.description: Heading of the region of the two-factor authentication page that says whether it is on.

settings.two_factor.status.description: Term of the description list: whether two-factor authentication is on.

settings.two_factor.status.on.description: Value of the two-factor authentication term while it is on.

settings.two_factor.status.off.defaultMessage: Off. Signing in asks only for your password.
settings.two_factor.status.off.description: Text of the two-factor authentication page while it is off.

settings.two_factor.enrolled_at.description: Term of the description list: when two-factor authentication was turned on; the value is a date and time.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.remai.description: Term of the description list: how many recovery codes are left; the value is a number.

settings.two_factor.setup.title.description: Heading of the region that enrolls an authenticator app while two-factor authentication is off.

settings.two_factor.setup.description.defaultMessage: Add this account to an authenticator app on your phone. From then on, signing in also asks for the six-digit code that the app shows.
settings.two_factor.setup.description.description: Explanation above the button that starts setting up an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.start.description: Button that generates a new secret to add to an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.step.scan.defaultMessage: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or type the key below into it.
settings.two_factor.setup.step.scan.description: First step of setting up an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.step.confirm.defaultMessage: Enter the six-digit code that the app shows to turn on two-factor authentication.
settings.two_factor.setup.step.confirm.description: Second step of setting up an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.qr_code.defaultMessage: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.two_factor.setup.qr_code.description: Accessible name of the QR code image that holds the secret for the authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.secret.description: Label of the secret shown as text, for typing it into an authenticator app instead of scanning the QR code.

settings.two_factor.setup.code.descripti.defaultMessage: The six-digit code that the app shows now.
settings.two_factor.setup.code.descripti.description: Help under the code field that confirms the setup of an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.setup.submit.description: Button that turns two-factor authentication on with the code of the app.

settings.two_factor.setup.expired.defaultMessage: The setup took too long. Start again.
settings.two_factor.setup.expired.description: Error when the setup of an authenticator app expired (after 15 minutes) before its code was entered.

settings.two_factor.code.description: Label of the field for a code of the authenticator app or a recovery code.

settings.two_factor.code.description.defaultMessage: A code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
settings.two_factor.code.description.description: Help under the code field that confirms replacing the recovery codes or turning two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.code.required.description: Error of an empty code field.

settings.two_factor.code.invalid.defaultMessage: The code is incorrect or was already used.
settings.two_factor.code.invalid.description: Error of the code field when the server refused the code.

settings.two_factor.state_changed.defaultMessage: Two-factor authentication was changed elsewhere. The page now shows its current setting.
settings.two_factor.state_changed.description: Error when two-factor authentication was turned on or off in another tab or device meanwhile.

settings.two_factor.rate_limited.description: Error after too many wrong codes. {reason} is the server's explanation of when to try again.

settings.two_factor.failed.description: Error when a change of two-factor authentication failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

settings.two_factor.enabled.description: Status message after turning two-factor authentication on.

settings.two_factor.disabled.description: Status message after turning two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.title.description: Heading of the region that replaces the recovery codes.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.descr.defaultMessage: If you lose your authenticator app, sign in with a recovery code instead. Each code works once. New codes replace the old ones, which stop working.
settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.descr.description: Explanation of the recovery codes above the form that replaces them.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.repla.description: Button that replaces the recovery codes with new ones.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.repla.defaultMessage: New recovery codes are ready. The old ones no longer work.
settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.repla.description: Status message after replacing the recovery codes.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.new.t.description: Heading of the list of new recovery codes, which is shown only once.

settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.new.d.defaultMessage: Keep these codes somewhere safe, such as a password manager. They are shown only now. Each one signs you in once without the app.
settings.two_factor.recovery_codes.new.d.description: Text above the list of new recovery codes.

settings.two_factor.disable.title.description: Heading of the region that turns two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.disable.description.defaultMessage: Signing in will ask only for your password. Enter a code to confirm.
settings.two_factor.disable.description.description: Explanation above the form that turns two-factor authentication off.

settings.two_factor.disable.submit.description: Button that turns two-factor authentication off.

settings.passkeys.title.description: Title of the settings page of passkeys (WebAuthn credentials that sign in instead of the password), and its entry in the settings menu.

settings.passkeys.description.defaultMessage: A passkey signs you in with the fingerprint, face, or PIN that unlocks your device or password manager, instead of your password. If two-factor authentication is on, signing in still asks for its code. Once you have a passkey, you can remove your password on the password page.
settings.passkeys.description.description: Explanation at the top of the passkeys settings page.

settings.passkeys.add.title.description: Heading of the form that adds a passkey on the passkeys settings page.

settings.passkeys.add.description.defaultMessage: Name the passkey so that you can tell it apart, and enter your password to confirm. Your browser then asks where to save the passkey.
settings.passkeys.add.description.description: Explanation of the form that adds a passkey.

settings.passkeys.add.description_passke.defaultMessage: Name the passkey so that you can tell it apart. Your browser asks for one of your passkeys to confirm, then where to save the new one.
settings.passkeys.add.description_passke.description: Explanation of the form that adds a passkey for a user who has no password: an existing passkey confirms adding the new one.

settings.passkeys.name.description: Label of the field for the name of a new passkey.

settings.passkeys.name.description.defaultMessage: Such as the device or password manager that keeps it.
settings.passkeys.name.description.description: Hint under the field for the name of a new passkey.

settings.passkeys.name.required.description: Error of the empty name field of a new passkey.

settings.passkeys.password.description: Label of the password field that confirms adding a passkey.

settings.passkeys.password.description.defaultMessage: Adding a way to sign in needs your password.
settings.passkeys.password.description.description: Hint under the password field that confirms adding a passkey.

settings.passkeys.password.required.description: Error of the empty password field when adding a passkey.

settings.passkeys.add.submit.description: Button that adds a passkey: it checks the password and opens the browser's prompt.

settings.passkeys.add.wrong_password.description: Error of the password field when the server refused the password that confirms adding a passkey.

settings.passkeys.add.cancelled.defaultMessage: No passkey was added: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.
settings.passkeys.add.cancelled.description: Alert when the user dismissed the browser's passkey prompt or it timed out.

settings.passkeys.add.exists.defaultMessage: This device or password manager already has a passkey for your account.
settings.passkeys.add.exists.description: Alert when the authenticator already holds a passkey of the account.

settings.passkeys.add.unavailable.defaultMessage: The browser could not create a passkey for this site.
settings.passkeys.add.unavailable.description: Alert when the browser refused to create a passkey for another reason (unsupported, or the site's address does not allow it).

settings.passkeys.add.invalid.defaultMessage: The passkey could not be verified. Try again with another device or password manager.
settings.passkeys.add.invalid.description: Alert when the server could not verify the new passkey (for example, the device has no screen lock).

settings.passkeys.add.expired.defaultMessage: Adding the passkey took too long. Try again.
settings.passkeys.add.expired.description: Alert when the passkey was created after the registration expired (5 minutes).

settings.passkeys.add.too_many.defaultMessage: You have as many passkeys as allowed. Remove one first.
settings.passkeys.add.too_many.description: Alert when the user already has the most passkeys allowed (20).

settings.passkeys.add.rate_limited.description: Alert when too many wrong passwords were entered to add a passkey. {reason} is the server's message, which says when to try again.

settings.passkeys.add.failed.description: Alert when adding a passkey failed for another reason. {reason} is the error's message.

settings.passkeys.added.description: Status after a passkey was added. {name} is the name the user gave it.

settings.passkeys.unsupported.defaultMessage: This browser cannot create passkeys. Open this page in a browser that supports them to add one.
settings.passkeys.unsupported.description: Note instead of the form that adds a passkey, in a browser without passkey support.

settings.passkeys.list.title.description: Heading of the list of the user's passkeys.

settings.passkeys.empty.description: Empty state of the list of the user's passkeys.

settings.passkeys.added_at.description: When a passkey was added, under its name. {date} is a formatted date and time.

settings.passkeys.remove.description: Button that removes a passkey, and the confirm button of its dialog.

settings.passkeys.remove.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms removing a passkey. {name} is its name.

settings.passkeys.remove.description.defaultMessage: You will no longer be able to sign in with it. Delete it from your device or password manager too.
settings.passkeys.remove.description.description: Explanation in the dialog that confirms removing a passkey.

settings.passkeys.remove.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog without removing the passkey.

settings.passkeys.remove.failed.description: Alert in the dialog when removing a passkey failed. {reason} is the error's message.

settings.passkeys.removed.description: Announcement after a passkey was removed. {name} is its name.

settings.password.title.description: Title of the settings page that changes the password, and its entry in the settings menu.

settings.password.description.defaultMessage: Changing the password signs you out of every other browser and app. Your passkeys and two-factor authentication stay as they are.
settings.password.description.description: Text at the top of the settings page that changes the password.

settings.password.change.title.description: Heading of the form that changes the password with the current one, on the password settings page.

settings.password.current.description: Label of the field of the current password, which confirms a password change.

settings.password.current.required.description: Error of the empty current password field when changing the password.

settings.password.wrong_password.description: Error of the current password field when the server refused it.

settings.password.new.description: Label of the field of the new password.

settings.password.new.description.description: Hint under the new password field. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

settings.password.new.invalid.description: Error of the new password field when it is empty, too short, or too long. {min} and {max} are the allowed lengths in characters.

settings.password.changed.defaultMessage: Your password is changed. Other browsers and apps are signed out.
settings.password.changed.description: Status after the password was changed.

settings.password.rate_limited.description: Alert when too many wrong current passwords were entered to change the password. {reason} is the server's message, which says when to try again.

settings.password.failed.description: Alert when changing the password failed for another reason. {reason} is the error's message.

settings.password.remove.title.description: Heading of the section that removes the password, so that only passkeys sign in, on the password settings page.

settings.password.remove.description.defaultMessage: Sign in with your passkeys only. One of your passkeys confirms the removal, and you are signed out of every other browser and app. You can set a password again on this page or with a password reset link.
settings.password.remove.description.description: Explanation of the section that removes the password.

settings.password.remove.no_passkey.defaultMessage: Add a passkey before you remove the password, so that you can still sign in.
settings.password.remove.no_passkey.description: Note instead of the button that removes the password, for a user who has no passkey.

settings.password.remove.open.description: Button that opens the dialog that removes the password.

settings.password.remove.confirm.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms removing the password.

settings.password.remove.confirm.descrip.defaultMessage: From now on you sign in with your passkeys only. Your browser asks for one of them to confirm.
settings.password.remove.confirm.descrip.description: Description of the dialog that removes the password: the confirm button opens the browser's passkey prompt.

settings.password.remove.confirm.description: Button in the dialog that removes the password after the browser's passkey prompt.

settings.password.remove.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog without removing the password.

settings.password.removed.defaultMessage: Your password is removed. Sign in with your passkeys from now on. Other browsers and apps are signed out.
settings.password.removed.description: Status after the password was removed.

settings.password.remove.failed.description: Alert in the dialog when removing the password failed. {reason} is the error's message.

settings.password.set.title.description: Heading of the form that sets a password for a user who removed theirs and signs in with passkeys only.

settings.password.set.description.defaultMessage: You sign in with your passkeys. Set a password to sign in with your email address and password too. Your browser asks for one of your passkeys to confirm, and you are signed out of every other browser and app.
settings.password.set.description.description: Explanation of the form that sets a password for a user who has none.

settings.password.set.submit.description: Button that sets a password after the browser's passkey prompt, for a user who has none.

settings.password.set.done.defaultMessage: Your password is set. Other browsers and apps are signed out.
settings.password.set.done.description: Status after a user who had no password set one.

settings.password.passkeys_unsupported.defaultMessage: This browser cannot use passkeys, which confirm this. Open this page in a browser that supports them.
settings.password.passkeys_unsupported.description: Note instead of a form or button of the password page that a passkey confirms (removing or setting the password), in a browser without passkey support.

settings.passkey_confirmation.cancelled.defaultMessage: Your passkey was not used: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.
settings.passkey_confirmation.cancelled.description: Alert when the user dismissed the browser's passkey prompt that confirms an operation (deleting the account, setting or removing the password, adding a passkey), or it timed out.

settings.passkey_confirmation.unavailabl.defaultMessage: The browser could not use a passkey for this site.
settings.passkey_confirmation.unavailabl.description: Alert when the browser refused the passkey prompt that confirms an operation for another reason (unsupported, or the site's address).

settings.passkey_confirmation.invalid.defaultMessage: The passkey could not be verified. Use a passkey of this account.
settings.passkey_confirmation.invalid.description: Alert when the server did not accept the passkey that confirms an operation (another account's passkey, a removed one, or one that does not verify).

settings.passkey_confirmation.expired.defaultMessage: Confirming with the passkey took too long. Try again.
settings.passkey_confirmation.expired.description: Alert when the passkey that confirms an operation was given after the confirmation expired (5 minutes).

settings.visibility.direct.description: Visibility option: only the mentioned accounts.

settings.visibility.direct.description.description: Description of the 'Mentioned people' visibility option.

settings.visibility.local.description: Visibility option: signed-in users of this server and followers.

settings.visibility.local.description.defaultMessage: People signed in to this server, and your followers
settings.visibility.local.description.description: Description of the 'This server' visibility option.

settings.visibility.private.description: Visibility option: followers and mentioned accounts.

settings.visibility.private.description.defaultMessage: Your followers and the people you mention

settings.visibility.public.description: Visibility option: everyone, listed on public timelines.

settings.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: Everyone, and shown on public timelines

settings.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility option: everyone, but kept off public timelines.

settings.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: Everyone, but kept off public timelines

shell.about.domain.description: In the side column about this server: the domain of the handles of local accounts, for example 'Accounts here end with @example.com.'.

shell.about.more.description: Link to the server's information page: in the side column about this server, in the menu sheet, and on the landing page.

shell.about.title.description: Heading of the side column, shown on wide screens, that tells about the server the user is on.

shell.document_title.description: The browser tab title: the heading of the current page, then the server's name.

shell.error.forbidden.heading.defaultMessage: You do not have permission to see this page
shell.error.forbidden.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the server refused the user (a 403); the server's reason follows.

shell.error.network.heading.defaultMessage: Could not connect to the server
shell.error.network.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the page got no answer from the server (offline, or the server is down).

shell.error.not_found.heading.defaultMessage: What this page shows was not found
shell.error.not_found.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the server found nothing to show (a 404); the server's reason follows.

shell.error.retry.description: Button that loads the failed page again.

shell.error.server.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the server failed to answer its request; the server's reason follows.

shell.error.title.description: Heading of the page shown when a screen failed to load or broke.

shell.error.unexpected.heading.defaultMessage: This page could not be shown
shell.error.unexpected.heading.description: Heading of the error that replaces a page's content when the page itself broke (not a failed request).

shell.error.unexpected.reason.defaultMessage: Try again, or come back later.
shell.error.unexpected.reason.description: Text under the heading of a page's error when the page itself broke.

shell.link.new_tab.description: Text that only assistive technology reads, after the name of every link that opens in a new browser tab (a link that leaves the app: another site, the source code, the server's terms). Keep the brackets so that it reads apart from the link's name.

shell.loading.description: Accessible name of the progress indicator shown while a page loads.

shell.menu.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the navigation menu's sheet.

shell.menu.title.description: Heading and accessible name of the sheet that the tab bar's menu button opens on phones, with the navigation items that are not in the tab bar.

shell.nav.about.description: Navigation item, shown while nobody is signed in, that opens the page about this server. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the bottom tab bar of phones and in the side rail of tablets.

shell.nav.admin.description: Navigation item to the server administration screens, shown only to users whose roles have a server administration permission.

shell.nav.finance.description: Navigation item to the finances page, shown only to users whose roles have the view_finance permission.

shell.nav.bookmarks.description: Navigation item that opens the list of the posts the user bookmarked. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.home.description: Navigation item that opens the home timeline. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.label.description: Accessible name of the main navigation (the tab bar on phones, the side rail on larger screens).

shell.nav.landing.description: Description read after the name of the link that shows the server's name (above the desktop sidebar, in the side column about this server, in the menu sheet) and opens the root address: the landing page for visitors, the home timeline for signed-in users.

shell.nav.local.description: Navigation item that opens the local timeline (posts of this server's accounts). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the bottom tab bar of phones and in the side rail of tablets.

shell.nav.menu.description: Button of the bottom tab bar on phones that opens a sheet with the rest of the navigation (profile, settings). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bar of five items on a 320 px screen.

shell.nav.menu_pending.defaultMessage: Menu, {count, plural, one {# pending in moderation} other {# pending in moderation}}
shell.nav.menu_pending.description: Accessible name of the phone tab bar's Menu button while things await the moderators in the moderation, which the menu leads to; starts with the visible label.

shell.nav.moderation.description: Navigation item to the moderation screens, shown only to users whose roles have a moderation permission.

shell.nav.moderation_pending.defaultMessage: Moderation, {count, plural, one {# pending} other {# pending}}
shell.nav.moderation_pending.description: Accessible name of the navigation item to the moderation screens while open reports, registrations or appeals wait for the moderators; starts with the visible label.

shell.nav.notifications.description: Navigation item that opens the notifications. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications_unread.defaultMessage: Notifications, {count, plural, one {# unread} other {# unread}}
shell.nav.notifications_unread.description: Accessible name of the navigation item that opens the notifications while some are unread. Start it with the text of shell.nav.notifications, which is shown. {count} is the number of unread notifications.

shell.nav.profile.description: Navigation item that opens the user's own profile. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.public.description: Navigation item that opens the federated timeline (public posts of this server and of other servers). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the bottom tab bar of phones and in the side rail of tablets.

shell.nav.search.description: Navigation item that opens the account search. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation item that opens the settings. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.sign_in.description: Navigation item, shown while nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page and comes back to the current page. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the bottom tab bar of phones and in the side rail of tablets.

shell.nav.sign_up.description: Navigation item, shown while nobody is signed in and the server takes new accounts, that opens the server's registration page. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.viewer.defaultMessage: The account you are signed in with
shell.nav.viewer.description: Description read after the name of the link at the bottom of the desktop sidebar that shows the signed-in account (avatar, display name, handle) and opens its profile.

shell.not_found.body.defaultMessage: There is no page at this address.
shell.not_found.body.description: Text on the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.not_found.home.description: Link, for a signed-in user, on a page with nothing to show (an address with no page, an account that is not there, a timeline the server turned off) that opens the home timeline.

shell.not_found.landing.description: Link, for a visitor who is not signed in, on a page with nothing to show (an address with no page, an account that is not there, a timeline the server turned off) that opens the server's landing page at the root address.

shell.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.offline.defaultMessage: You are offline. Anything that failed to load loads again when you are back online.
shell.offline.description: Text of the bar at the top of the app while the device is offline or the server cannot be reached. Screen readers announce it when it appears.

shell.rate_limited.defaultMessage: Too many requests were sent to the server. What failed to load loads again at {time}.
shell.rate_limited.description: Text of the bar at the top of the app while the server's rate limit refuses requests (HTTP 429). {time} is the time of day the app loads again, with seconds (for example 12:34:56). Screen readers announce it when it appears.

shell.skip_to_main.description: Link at the very start of every page, visible when focused, that moves keyboard focus past the navigation.

shell.startup_error.body.defaultMessage: The server sent settings the app cannot read. Reload the page; if this keeps happening, tell the server's administrator.
shell.startup_error.body.description: Text shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.startup_error.title.description: Heading shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.toast.dismiss.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes a toast message.

shell.toast.region.description: Accessible name of the area where short status messages (toasts) appear, such as 'Post published'.

shell.update.apply.description: Button in the message about a new version of the app; pressing it reloads the page into the new version.

shell.update.available.defaultMessage: A new version of the app is available.
shell.update.available.description: Message shown when a new version of the web app has been downloaded and waits until the user applies it.

status.action.bookmark.description: Toggle button under a post that bookmarks it or removes the bookmark. Bookmarks are private. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.boost.description: Toggle button under a post that shares (boosts) it with the user's followers, or retracts the boost. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.copy_link.description: Menu item that copies the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.action.delete.description: Menu item, on the user's own post, that asks to delete it.

status.action.edit.description: Item of a post's More actions menu, for the user's own posts: opens the dialog that edits the post.

status.action.failed.description: Toast when boosting, favouriting or bookmarking a post failed; the button is set back. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.action.favourite.description: Toggle button under a post that adds it to or removes it from the user's favourites. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.more.description: Button under a post that opens a menu with more actions on it, and the name of that menu.

status.action.reply.description: Button under a post that starts a reply to it.

status.bookmark.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed the bookmark of a post.

status.bookmark.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user bookmarked a post.

status.boost.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user retracted the boost of a post.

status.boost.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user boosted a post.

status.delete.cancel.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that keeps the post.

status.delete.confirm.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that deletes the post.

status.delete.description.defaultMessage: It will be removed for everyone, along with its boosts and favourites. You cannot undo this.
status.delete.description.description: Text of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.delete.done.description: Toast after the user's post was deleted.

status.delete.failed.description: Toast when deleting the user's post failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.delete.title.description: Heading of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.edit.cancel.description: Button of the dialog that edits the user's post: closes it without saving.

status.edit.close.description: Accessible name of the close (x) button of the dialog that edits the user's post.

status.edit.done.description: Toast after the user's post was edited and saved.

status.edit.failed.description: Shown in the dialog that edits the user's post when saving failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.edit.fixed.defaultMessage: The visibility and the post it replies to stay as they are.
status.edit.fixed.description: Note in the dialog that edits the user's post: an edit cannot change these.

status.edit.load_failed.defaultMessage: Could not load the post to edit: {reason}
status.edit.load_failed.description: Shown in the dialog that edits the user's post when its text failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.edit.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while the dialog that edits the user's post loads its text.

status.edit.retry.description: Button that loads the post to edit again after it failed.

status.edit.save.description: Submit button of the dialog that edits the user's post.

status.edit.title.description: Heading of the dialog that edits the user's post, and the name of its form.

status.edited.description: Link under an edited post to its edit history.

status.federation.stays_local.description: Short note at the end of the action bar of a post of another server while this server sends nothing to other servers (federation direction 'Receive only' or 'Off', ADR-0076): replies, boosts, favourites and reactions are recorded on this server but do not reach the post's server. It also describes those buttons.

status.favourite.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed a post from their favourites.

status.favourite.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user favourited a post.

status.focused.boosts.description: Under the body of the post a page is about: how many times it was boosted. Shown only when it was.

status.focused.favourites.description: Under the body of the post a page is about: how many people favourited it. Shown only when someone did.

status.focused.label.description: Not shown: read out by screen readers before the author and time of the post a page is about, to tell it apart from the posts of its thread.

status.history.back.description: Link from a post's edit history to the post's page.

status.history.change.media.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: the attached media or their descriptions.

status.history.change.sensitive.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: whether the media are marked sensitive.

status.history.change.text.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: the text of the post.

status.history.change.warning.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: the content warning.

status.history.changes.description: What a revision of a post changed from the one before. {changes} is a list of the changes, like text, content warning.

status.history.current.description: Label of the revision that is the post's content now, in the edit history.

status.history.list.description: Accessible name of the list of the revisions of a post.

status.history.original.description: Label of the revision that is the post as first written, in the edit history.

status.history.title.description: Heading and title of the page that lists the revisions of a post.

status.link.copied.description: Toast after the address of a post was copied to the clipboard.

status.link.failed.description: Toast when the browser refused to copy the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.not_found.body.defaultMessage: This post does not exist, or you cannot see it.
status.not_found.body.description: Text under the heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.original.description: Accessible name of the link on a post of another server to its page on that server; the link shows only {host}, that server's host name, for example 'mastodon.social'.

status.pin.action.description: Menu item, on the user's own post, that pins it to the top of their profile.

status.pin.done.description: Toast after the user pinned their post to their profile.

status.pin.failed.description: Toast when pinning the user's post failed, for example because they already pinned as many posts as allowed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.pin.label.description: Line above a post at the top of a profile that the account pinned there.

status.poll.choose_many.description: Hint above the options of a poll that lets the user choose several of them.

status.poll.choose_one.description: Hint under the options of a poll that lets the user choose one of them.

status.poll.closed.description: Under a poll whose end has passed: it takes no more votes and shows its results.

status.poll.ends.description: Under a poll: when it ends. {time} is a relative time ahead, such as "in 3 hr." or "in 2 days".

status.poll.hidden.defaultMessage: The votes of each option are shown when the poll ends.
status.poll.hidden.description: Under a poll whose author hides the votes of each option until it ends, in place of the shares of the votes.

status.poll.label.description: Accessible name of the poll of a post: its options or results and how many voted.

status.poll.options.description: Accessible name of the group of radio buttons or checkboxes the user chooses from to vote in a poll.

status.poll.own_vote.description: After an option in the results of a poll that the user voted for.

status.poll.remote_counts.description: Under the results of a poll of a post from another server: the counts are those that server sent last, and a vote of the user shows in them once it sends them again. {host} is that server's host name.

status.poll.results.description: Accessible name of the list of the options of a poll with their share of the votes.

status.poll.vote.description: Button under the options of a poll that sends the user's choice.

status.poll.vote_failed.description: Toast when the user's vote in a poll failed, for example because the poll has ended. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.poll.voted.description: Toast after the user voted in a poll.

status.poll.voters.description: Under a poll: how many accounts voted.

status.poll.votes.description: Under a poll whose number of voters is unknown: how many votes it has, one per chosen option.

status.unpin.action.description: Menu item, on the user's own pinned post, that removes it from the top of their profile.

status.unpin.done.description: Toast after the user unpinned their post from their profile.

status.unpin.failed.description: Toast when unpinning the user's post failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.thread.ancestors.description: Heading above the posts that the post of the page replies to, oldest first.

status.thread.failed.description: Shown under the post of the page when its thread failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.thread.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy replies section while the thread around a post loads.

status.thread.no_replies.description: Shown under the Replies heading when the post has no replies.

status.thread.replies.description: Heading above the replies to the post of the page.

status.thread.retry.description: Button that loads the thread around a post again after a failure.

status.title.description: Heading of the page of one post and the thread around it.

tag.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the posts of one hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #, for example 'cats'.

timeline.boosted_by.description: Line above a post in a timeline that someone else shared (boosted). {name} is the display name of the account that boosted it.

timeline.content_warning.toggle.description: Button next to a post's content warning that shows or hides the post behind it. The same text is used while the post is shown.

timeline.empty.account.heading.description: Shown instead of the posts of a profile's tab when it has none.

timeline.empty.bookmarks.description.defaultMessage: Posts you bookmark appear here. Only you can see your bookmarks.
timeline.empty.bookmarks.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty list of bookmarks.

timeline.empty.bookmarks.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the user has bookmarked none.

timeline.empty.home.action.description: Link from the empty home timeline to the local timeline, where the user can find people to follow.

timeline.empty.home.description.defaultMessage: Your posts and the posts of the people you follow appear here.
timeline.empty.home.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty home timeline.

timeline.empty.home.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the home timeline has none.

timeline.empty.local.description.defaultMessage: Public posts of the people on this server appear here.
timeline.empty.local.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty local timeline.

timeline.empty.local.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the local timeline has none.

timeline.empty.public.description.defaultMessage: Public posts of people here and on the servers this one knows will appear here.
timeline.empty.public.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty federated timeline.

timeline.empty.public.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the federated timeline has none.

timeline.empty.tag.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty hashtag timeline. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.empty.tag.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when no post has the hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.keyboard_hint.defaultMessage: In the timeline, Page Down and Page Up move between posts.
timeline.keyboard_hint.description: Hint for screen reader users before a timeline, about the keys that move from post to post.

timeline.load_more.description: Button at the end of a timeline that loads older posts.

timeline.load_more.failed.description: Message, read out and shown at the end of a timeline, when older posts failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy region while posts load: the first page of a timeline, or a post page.

timeline.media.no_description.description: Badge on a picture of a post whose author gave no description (alternative text); screen readers read it as the picture's name.

timeline.media.reveal.description: Toggle button over the pictures of a post that the author marked sensitive; it shows or hides them.

timeline.media.audio.play.description: Accessible name of the play button of the audio player of a post's audio attachment.

timeline.media.audio.pause.description: Accessible name of the pause button of the audio player of a post's audio attachment, shown while the audio plays.

timeline.media.audio.seek.description: Accessible name of the seek slider of the audio player of a post's audio attachment; arrow keys move the playback position.

timeline.media.viewer.title.description: Heading of the image viewer, the dialog that shows a picture of a post at its original size when it is pressed. {position} is the place of the picture among the post's pictures, from 1; {count} is how many there are.

timeline.media.viewer.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the image viewer.

timeline.media.viewer.previous.description: Accessible name of the icon button of the image viewer that shows the post's picture before the current one.

timeline.media.viewer.next.description: Accessible name of the icon button of the image viewer that shows the post's next picture.

timeline.media.viewer.position.description: Position of the picture shown in the image viewer among the post's pictures, between its previous and next buttons. {position} is the place of the picture, from 1; {count} is how many there are.

timeline.media.viewer.alt_text.description: Accessible name of the note button of the image viewer that shows or hides the picture's description (alt text) over the picture. The button exists only for a picture that has a description.

timeline.card.author.description: Line under the description of a link card naming the author of the linked page. {author} is the author's name as the page gives it, or the verified account (timeline.card.account).

timeline.card.author_published.description: Line under the description of a link card naming the author of the linked page and when it was published. {author} is the author's name; {date} is the formatted date.

timeline.card.published.description: Line under the description of a link card saying when the linked page was published. {date} is the formatted date.

timeline.card.account.description: The verified author of a linked page as an account: {name} is the display name, {handle} the handle such as @alice@example.com.

timeline.card.failed.defaultMessage: Could not show the preview of this link.
timeline.card.failed.description: Shown in place of the card of a link in a post when it failed to render.

timeline.new_posts.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# new post} other {# new posts}}
timeline.new_posts.description: Button above the home timeline when new posts have arrived; pressing it shows them at the top. Screen readers also read it out when the count changes.

timeline.new_posts.failed.defaultMessage: Could not load the new posts: {reason}
timeline.new_posts.failed.description: Message read out when pressing the new posts button failed to load them. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.offline.home.defaultMessage: You are offline. These are the posts as of {time}.
timeline.offline.home.description: Notice above the home timeline while the device is offline or the server cannot be reached: the posts shown are the ones loaded last, kept on this device. {time} is the date and time they were loaded, already formatted.

timeline.retry.description: Button at the end of a timeline that tries again to load older posts after a failure.

timeline.signed_out.action.description: Link on the home page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

timeline.signed_out.description.defaultMessage: Sign in to read the posts of the people you follow.
timeline.signed_out.description.description: Text on the home page when nobody is signed in.

timeline.signed_out.heading.description: Heading on the home page when nobody is signed in, shown instead of the home timeline.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_crea.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator registered a custom emoji of this server.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_imag.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator replaced the image of a custom emoji.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_copi.defaultMessage: Custom emoji copied from another server
admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_copi.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator copied another server's custom emoji into a new emoji of this server.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_upda.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator changed the category, other names, or place in the picker of a custom emoji.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_enab.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator enabled a custom emoji, which is shown again.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_disa.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator disabled a custom emoji, which is shown nowhere.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_dele.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator deleted a custom emoji of this server.

admin.audit_log.target_kind.announcement.description: Kind of target of an audited operation: an announcement, shown by the first line of its text.

admin.audit_log.target_kind.custom_emoji.description: Kind of target of an audited operation: a custom emoji, shown as :shortcode:.

admin.custom_emojis.title.description: Heading of the custom emoji screen, and its link in the administration menu.

admin.custom_emojis.summary.defaultMessage: Register this server's custom emoji, and disable those of other servers.
admin.custom_emojis.summary.description: Description of the custom emoji screen in the administration menu of the settings.

admin.custom_emojis.new.title.description: Heading of the form that registers a custom emoji of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.image.description: Label of the image of a custom emoji, in the form and in an emoji's details.

admin.custom_emojis.image.description.defaultMessage: PNG, GIF, or WebP, at most 1,024 pixels on each side. It is shown within 256 pixels; an animated PNG shows its first frame only.
admin.custom_emojis.image.description.description: Help of the image of a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.image.choose.description: Button that opens the file chooser for the image of a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.image.chosen.description: The image file chosen for a new custom emoji. {name} is the file name.

admin.custom_emojis.image.large_hint.defaultMessage: This image is larger than 100 KB. Some servers (GoToSocial by default) do not show custom emoji that large.
admin.custom_emojis.image.large_hint.description: Note under a chosen custom emoji image larger than 100 KB; it can still be registered.

admin.custom_emojis.image.required.description: Error of the custom emoji form submitted without an image.

admin.custom_emojis.image_failed.defaultMessage: The server could not process the image.
admin.custom_emojis.image_failed.description: Reason of a failed registration or image replacement when the server could not process the uploaded image.

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.description: Label of the shortcode of a new custom emoji: the name people type between colons.

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.descriptio.defaultMessage: 2 to 30 letters (A to Z), digits, and underscores; capitals count. People type it between colons, like :blobcat:. It cannot be changed later.
admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.descriptio.description: Help of the shortcode of a new custom emoji. :blobcat: is an example (not translated).

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.defaultMessage: Use 2 to 30 letters (A to Z), digits, and underscores.
admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.description: Error of a shortcode that is empty or breaks the rules.

admin.custom_emojis.category.description: Label of the category that groups a custom emoji in the picker.

admin.custom_emojis.category.description.defaultMessage: Groups the emoji in the picker. Optional, up to {max} characters.
admin.custom_emojis.category.description.description: Help of the category of a custom emoji. {max} is the most characters.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description: Label of the other names that the picker's search finds a custom emoji by.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description.defaultMessage: Names that the picker's search also finds the emoji by, separated by spaces or commas; up to {max}, each like a shortcode.
admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description.description: Help of the other names of a custom emoji. {max} is the most names.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.too_many.description: Error of more other names than allowed. {max} is the most names.

admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.description: Checkbox of whether the picker offers a custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.de.defaultMessage: An emoji hidden from the picker can still be typed as its :shortcode:.
admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.de.description: Help of the checkbox of whether the picker offers a custom emoji. :shortcode: is not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.created_by.description: Term of the description list of a local custom emoji: the account of the user who made it.

admin.custom_emojis.created_by.deleted.description: Value of 'Made by' for a custom emoji whose creator's account is deleted.

admin.custom_emojis.created_by.none.description: Value of 'Made by' for a custom emoji registered with the my command, not by a user.

admin.custom_emojis.tabs.label.description: Accessible name of the tab list of the custom emoji screen: the emoji and the requests for new ones.

admin.custom_emojis.tabs.emoji.description: Tab of the custom emoji screen: registering and managing the emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.tabs.requests.description: Tab of the custom emoji screen: the requests of users for new custom emoji, which administrators approve or reject.

admin.custom_emojis.tabs.pending.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# request awaits review} other {# requests await review}}
admin.custom_emojis.tabs.pending.description: Accessible name of the count on the Requests tab: how many custom emoji requests await review.

admin.custom_emojis.tabs.pending_more.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {More than # request awaits review} other {More than # requests await review}}
admin.custom_emojis.tabs.pending_more.description: Accessible name of the count on the Requests tab when there are more pending requests than one page shows.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.title.description: Heading of the region of the requests tab of the custom emoji screen.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.description.defaultMessage: Users whose roles let them create custom emoji request new emoji and new images of the ones they made. A request is no emoji until it is approved: nothing shows its image. Approving makes the emoji, in the picker; rejecting frees its shortcode, and the requester sees the reason.
admin.custom_emoji_requests.description.description: Explanation at the top of the requests tab of the custom emoji screen (ADR-0070).

admin.custom_emoji_requests.state.description: Label of the select of the state of the listed custom emoji requests.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.empty.pendin.description: Empty state of the pending custom emoji requests.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.empty.description: Empty state of the custom emoji requests in a state other than pending.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.requester.description: Term of the description list of a custom emoji request: the requester's account.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.requester.de.description: Value of 'Requested by' when the requester's account is deleted.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.approve.description: Button that approves a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.approve_requ.description: Accessible name of the button that approves a custom emoji request. {emoji} is the :shortcode: of the requested emoji.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.approved.description: Status after approving a custom emoji request. {emoji} is the :shortcode: of the emoji.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.reject.description: Button that rejects a custom emoji request, and the confirm button of its dialog.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.reject_reque.description: Accessible name of the button that rejects a custom emoji request. {emoji} is the :shortcode: of the requested emoji.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.reject.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms rejecting a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.reject.descr.defaultMessage: The requester is notified and sees the reason, if you give one. The shortcode becomes free again.
admin.custom_emoji_requests.reject.descr.description: Description of the dialog that confirms rejecting a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.rejected.description: Status after rejecting a custom emoji request. {emoji} is the :shortcode: of the emoji.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.reason.description: Label of the optional reason of a rejection of a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.reason.descr.description: Description of the reason of a rejection of a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.reason.too_l.defaultMessage: A reason is at most {max} characters.
admin.custom_emoji_requests.reason.too_l.description: Error of a reason of a rejection that is too long. {max} is the limit.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.characters_l.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
admin.custom_emoji_requests.characters_l.description: Characters left in the reason of a rejection of a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.characters_o.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character too many} other {# characters too many}}
admin.custom_emoji_requests.characters_o.description: Characters over the limit of the reason of a rejection of a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog that rejects a custom emoji request.

admin.custom_emoji_requests.decide_faile.description: Error after approving or rejecting a custom emoji request failed. {reason} is the server's explanation.

admin.custom_emojis.submit.description: Button that registers a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.created.description: Status after registering a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.create_failed.defaultMessage: Could not register the custom emoji: {reason}
admin.custom_emojis.create_failed.description: Error under the form when registering a custom emoji failed. {reason} is the localized reason.

admin.custom_emojis.list.title.description: Heading of the list of custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the tabs that choose the custom emoji of this server or of other servers.

admin.custom_emojis.filter.local.description: Tab of the custom emoji registered on this server.

admin.custom_emojis.filter.remote.description: Tab of the custom emoji that came from posts and profiles of other servers.

admin.custom_emojis.search.label.description: Accessible name of the search form of the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.search.shortcode.description: Label of the search field of the custom emoji list: text that the shortcode contains.

admin.custom_emojis.search.domain.description: Label of the search field of another server's domain in the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.search.submit.description: Button of the search form of the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.search.clear.description: Button that clears the search of the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.description: Heading of the custom emoji list of this server when none is registered.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.descript.defaultMessage: Emoji registered here appear in the picker of the post form and the profile.
admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.descript.description: Description of the empty custom emoji list of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.remote.defaultMessage: No custom emoji of other servers
admin.custom_emojis.empty.remote.description: Heading of the custom emoji list of other servers when none has been seen.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.search.defaultMessage: No custom emoji match the search
admin.custom_emojis.empty.search.description: Heading of the custom emoji list when the search finds nothing.

admin.custom_emojis.domain.description: Term in a remote custom emoji's details: the domain it came from.

admin.custom_emojis.state.description: Term in a custom emoji's details: enabled or disabled.

admin.custom_emojis.state.enabled.description: State of a custom emoji that is shown.

admin.custom_emojis.state.disabled.description: State of a custom emoji that is shown nowhere: its :shortcode: stays text.

admin.custom_emojis.picker.description: Term in a custom emoji's details: whether the picker offers it.

admin.custom_emojis.picker.shown.description: Value of the picker term: the picker offers the emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.picker.hidden.description: Value of the picker term: the picker does not offer the emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.none.description: Value of a custom emoji's category or other names when it has none.

admin.custom_emojis.no_image.defaultMessage: Not shown (its server's media is rejected)
admin.custom_emojis.no_image.description: Value of a remote custom emoji's image when the server does not show it, because a domain action rejects the media of its server.

admin.custom_emojis.updated_at.description: Term in a custom emoji's details: when its current image was set.

admin.custom_emojis.edit.description: Button of a custom emoji that opens the dialog of its settings.

admin.custom_emojis.edit_emoji.description: Accessible name of the edit button of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.edit.title.description: Title of the dialog of a custom emoji's settings. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.edit.close.description: Accessible name of the close button of the dialog of a custom emoji's settings.

admin.custom_emojis.enabled.description: Checkbox of whether a custom emoji is shown.

admin.custom_emojis.enabled.description.defaultMessage: A disabled emoji is shown nowhere; its :shortcode: stays text.
admin.custom_emojis.enabled.description.description: Help of the checkbox of whether a custom emoji is shown. :shortcode: is not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.save.description: Button that saves the settings of a custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog of a custom emoji without changing it.

admin.custom_emojis.updated.description: Status after saving the settings of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.change_failed.defaultMessage: Could not change the custom emoji: {reason}
admin.custom_emojis.change_failed.description: Error when changing, replacing the image of, or deleting a custom emoji failed. {reason} is the localized reason.
